unit: pre-network physical HTTP opportunity to emit one full-question candidate output

phases.assignmentDesign: 25 active types x 2 plans, KILLER current-policy sentinel
phases.inferentialStatus: defect-discovery sentinel only; neither a quality-rate estimate nor production-parity evidence

phases.assignmentDesign: 4 frozen profiles x 2 focus types x 2 plans x 5 plan-specific dev passages; every passage-plan block receives all 4 profiles
phases.inferentialStatus: complete-block screening and winner selection only; no population quality claim

phases.assignmentDesign: 2 focus types x 2 policies (CURRENT/WINNER) x 60 independent KILLER passages; within each type 30 passages are STANDARD and 30 PREMIUM, both policies share each passage-plan block, and CURRENT/WINNER execution order is frozen 15/15 AB/BA within each type-plan stratum
phases.attritionRule: provider-attempt timeout, parse failure, cap exhaustion and policy no-output are ITT failures; missing corpus/review/provenance makes the phase incomplete and cannot be imputed or topped up
phases.inferentialStatus: planned paired sample is 60 pairs per type pooled across plan and 30 pairs per type-plan; adequacy is not established because alpha, multiplicity, MDE and discordance assumptions are unresolved

phases.assignmentDesign: 25 active types x 2 plans through the isolated production fast route; BASIC/INTERMEDIATE/KILLER are assigned on a frozen near-balanced 17/17/16 schedule across 50 cells, so no type has full three-difficulty coverage
phases.inferentialStatus: route/persistence/render/scoring smoke sentinel only; one cell cannot establish route parity or type/difficulty quality

phases.assignmentDesign: 6 preregistered grammar/blank boundary passages balanced 3/3 by type, 3/3 by plan and 2/2/2 by difficulty

preregistrationHolds: Freeze disjoint corpus rows, strata, total order, within-block execution order and hashes; do not replace or top up after any outcome is observed.
Freeze one primary estimand, exact test direction, alpha allocation, multiplicity family, MDE and winner/noninferiority/Pareto thresholds.
Freeze requested/effective/served model and provider assertions, endpoint price snapshot, per-stage token ceilings, physical-call caps, phase USD caps and a campaign USD cap.
Specify model/provider drift and incomplete-pair handling. A drifted or provenance-incomplete phase is invalid rather than repaired with new passages.
Reconcile the per-assignment candidate ceiling with the actual STANDARD, PREMIUM and grammar-ladder call graph. A budget-truncated policy cannot be labelled current production parity.
executionHold: This file is not an operational registry and authorizes zero calls.
Corpus v3 certification, trusted provider/parser instrumentation, immutable provenance and fresh audits must pass first.
Every phase needs frozen physical-call and USD caps derived from model token ceilings and a fresh endpoint-price snapshot.
The 10 safety slots are never executable or reallocatable, but ten slots alone do not prove the 1,000-output cap until output cardinality and concurrent in-flight overflow are bounded before network.
The current 1/2/3 candidate ceilings are arithmetic placeholders and must not be used to claim production parity.
A2/A3 winner, multiplicity, MDE and power rules are unresolved; A3 is not yet a confirmatory design.
